OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE ANNUAL IVTEETING
  Monday, April 1,2024

1.  WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER

  Chairman Craig Walters welcomed attendees. The following board members were
  present: Craig Walters, Zuhey Espinoza, and George Henderson. Not Present: Marianne
  Stark and Micky Rehm.

2.  CALENDAR

  Cool Cruise Car Show - Saturday, April 6'2024 - 10am-4pm
  Wine Walk - Saturday, April 27,,2024 - 5pm-8:30pm

3.  PRESENTATIONS

  Metro "A" (Gold) Line Update

  Lisa Levy Buch of the Gold Line Construction Authority presented a construction
  update.

  Mayor's City Update

  Mayor Hepburn provided a City update

  University of La Verne Update

  Dr. Zthey Espinoza provided an update on University events

  Old Town District & Association Report

  Chairman Craig Walters provided a District update and discussed upcoming Cool Cruise
  Car Show and Wine Walk.

4.  PIIBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  None
 5.  ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 9:30 a.m., the next regular meeting to be held on Monday,
  May 6, 2024 at 8:30 a.m. atCafd Wang Restaurant.
